# LicenseAnalyzer

> LicenseAnalyzer by Open iT provides comprehensive software license management, tracking, compliance, and cost optimization solutions for enterprises.

LicenseAnalyzer is a software license management platform that helps organizations gain visibility into their software usage, optimize licensing costs, and ensure compliance. The platform delivers real-time analytics and monitoring capabilities tailored for enterprises across industries including AEC, engineering, and Fortune 100 companies.
